This screen cannot show a search result
Both declared components bind Money — amount, currency, scale. A price is not a search result: there is no name to read, no id to select and nothing to navigate to. The four rows above are the declaration drawn literally. Two components, three columns, and the binding is a price object — this is a specification problem and drawing over it would hide it.

What a result needs
A usable result row needs a name, an id and a kind, and the panel needs a get to read one. None of the three are declared here. Left minimal on purpose.

sortOrder is the venue’s, not ours. Entry questions sit first because that is what a guest at the gate is asking.
Tickets and entry14 answers
Can I enter and leave on the same ticket?Yes on a day pass, up to four entries. The QR is re-read on the way back in, and the entry count is on your ticket in My Tickets.
What if I arrive after my session starts?A timed session admits you up to 30 minutes late. After that the entry is refused at the gate and the ticket becomes a credit rather than a loss.
Do children need their own ticket?Under threes are free and do not need one. Everyone else does, including anyone accompanying a child and not swimming.
My QR will not scan.The code rotates every 30 seconds, so a screenshot will not work. Open the ticket in the app or the browser you booked in and show the live one.
Can someone else use my ticket?Only if you transfer it. A transferred ticket is reissued to them and yours stops scanning — sharing a screenshot does not work and gets both of you stopped.
Still stuck
If the answer is not here, raise it and a person picks it up. Guest Services answer inside four hours during opening, same day otherwise.

We arrive Friday with a four-year-old. Which slides can she go on?
Four-year-olds can use the Kids’ Lagoon, the two family rafts on the lower tower and the lazy river with an adult. The tower slides need 1.2 m and the Flowrider needs 1.3 m, so those are out this visit.FAQ-SAFETY · height rulesFAQ-ENTRY
Is Friday very busy?
Friday is the busiest day of the week and the tower slides were at 45 minutes yesterday afternoon. Mornings before 11:00 are quieter, and the Kids’ Lagoon rarely queues.getWaitTimes · yesterdayvenue programme
Can you book us two adults and one child?
I can put it in your cart but I cannot pay for you. Two adult day passes and one child pass for Friday come to AED 740 before your Gold discount — shall I open the cart?ADR-0020 · read-onlyGOLDMEM applies

Answers, policies and the accessibility statement.
assets/ticvai-light-logo.png
Aqua Park Gate A · Marina Bay Entertainment DistrictOnline · liveAEDMarina Bay
AccessibilityDashboardMy ticketsOrdersProfileWalletlistFaqs · listContentPages
Accessibility at Marina Bay
Step-free access
Every pool, both restaurants and the arena are reachable without steps. Two of the four slide towers are not, and the map marks which.
→ WEB-039
Pool hoists
At the wave pool and the kids’ lagoon. Staffed, no notice needed, no charge.
2 locations
Carer tickets
A carer accompanying a disabled guest enters free. Bring the guest’s proof; the carer needs nothing.
free
Quiet hour
Fridays 08:00 to 09:00. Music off, wave machine off, half capacity. Booked as an ordinary day pass.
Fri 08:00
Changing Places
One full facility with a hoist and adult-sized bench, by Gate A. Radar key or ask any lifeguard.
Gate A
Assistance dogs
Welcome on site, not in the water. Shaded rest area by the arena.
welcome
This statement is the venue’s, and it is dated
Written 12 August 2026 against WCAG 2.2 AA for the site and a physical access audit for the venue. Both are re-checked annually, and the date is shown because an undated accessibility statement tells a guest nothing about whether it is still true.
noticeVersion v4.1
listContentPages is declared and reaches nothing. The FAQ entries load; the policy pages — accessibility statement, terms, privacy notice, house rules — are content pages, and without that call this screen can show the answers and not the policies they refer to.
